same_postal_inherited_coordinate_leads.disposition: Held; no candidate promoted because workbook coordinate column lacks independently verifiable row-level source URL/lineage for transfer.

decision: No new coordinates proposed. The only current high-confidence path to batch-fill remaining exact postal building points is OneMap, but ONEMAP_API_TOKEN is absent in this agent process. Existing open government datasets rechecked in Refresh130/133 contain no new exact matches under current policies. Mapbox was not used.
precision_policy: Do not label building or facility points as stall coordinates; require exact premises identity and source-reusable provenance. Do not infer from postal centroid or unverified workbook coordinate inheritance.
next_action: Run the already-authorized, rate-limited OneMap batch in the local process where the user-configured token is available, reuse only exact postal/building matches, preserve per-source precision and attribution, and write a checkpointed proposal first.
